When I placed my order on the 12th, your site showed the miner was in stock and would ship. It is now the 24th and I have not seen or heard anything about it shipping. The fact that it was in stock was one of the reasons I ordered from you.

Sent from my iPhone
Note to the team: I'll look into this. Let me check what I can find.

Hi,

I'm sorry. Twelve days with no word from us on an in stock item isn't right, and I'd like to get you a real answer rather than a generic one.

I can't pull your order up from this message on its own. Could you reply with your order number (it looks like Shop····, and it's at the top of your confirmation email), plus either the postcode ····to or the name on the order? With those I can see exactly where it is, whether it's been picked or labelled at the warehouse, and the ship date it carries, and I'll send you that in my next reply.

If you also tell me which miner you ordered, I'll check the stock position on it at the warehouse serving your address at the same time.

Sorry again for the silence on this.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hi Tim,

Thank you for the order number, and I'm sorry. I've pulled up Shop···· and you're right to be annoyed.

Your Hammer Miner DC04 was due to ship by October 19 and it hasn't left yet. There's no tracking on it, and nothing has been sent to you about the delay, which is the part that bothers me most. You shouldn't have had to write in to find that out.

I'm not going to invent a date for you. What I can see is that the unit hasn't shipped and there's no confirmed new ship date on your order. I've put it in front of the team with your order number so they can get the real date and the tracking from the people building it. They're offline over the weekend and pick this up Monday morning, 10am Eastern, and the answer comes to you by email on this thread. Your $329 is paid in full and nothing on your side is holding it up.

For the wait, I've put $25 off your next order on this one. The code is HD-••••••, it's yours alone and works on orders over $100.

One thing worth doing in the meantime: add (email hidden) and (email hidden) to your contacts. Our mail has been landing in junk for some customers, and your DHL tracking will come from there.

If you'd rather not keep waiting on the DC04 and want to look at something we can ship sooner, tell me and I'll lay out what's actually on the shelf for New Mexico with prices, no pressure either way.

Sorry again for the silence, Tim.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hi Tim,

You're right, and I'm sorry. You should have heard something on Monday. Silence after I told you someone would pick it up is worse than the original wait, and I'm not going to dress that up.

Here is exactly what I can see on Shop···· this morning. Your $329 is paid in full, the Hammer DC04 still has not shipped, there is no tracking on it, and there is still no confirmed new ship date on your order. That is the honest state of it, fifteen days after you ordered a unit the site said was in stock.

So rather than ask you to wait on another promise, here is something real I can do today. I can move your order onto a unit that is genuinely sitting on the shelf for your address in (address hidden) and ships within 2 business days. The nearest to what you bought is the Hammer DC06 at 330 MH/s, $379.99, which would be $80.99 more than the DC04 you paid for. There is also the Hammer DC08 at 480 MH/s for $539. If you would rather go to bitcoin instead of scrypt, the Hammer BC04 at 6 TH/s is $249, and the $50 difference goes back to your card. Say the word on any of those and I will make the change myself and confirm it in this thread, no waiting on anyone.

If you would rather hold out for the DC04, that is fine too. I have put your order back in front of the team this morning with everything above, and they are on at 10am Eastern today to chase a real ship date and tracking from the people building it. The answer comes to you here.

One thing from the weekend in case it did not reach you: I put $25 off your next order on this for the wait. The code is HD-••••••, yours alone, on orders over $100.

Tell me which way you want to go, Tim, and I will act on it straight away.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
